content.short: TokenTraxx is a web3 and music NFT platform founded by music industry professionals.
content.description: TokenTraxx envisions a new era for the music community by delivering fair rewards that can be shared by everyone. It views NFTs as the foundation of that future, with technology capable of redefining and elevating the value of music. Its mission is to be at the center of a new independent music creator economy powered by blockchain, offering a marketplace that redefines and strengthens music's financial value and supports the entire community.
